unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces
scanNote:
85-BET. Unit 12 'See New Places, Meet New Faces' — qiyoslash va ustunlik darajasi.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. 11a, 12a, 12b va 13-mashqlarning barcha javoblari TO'G'RI.

12b — dunyo rekordlari. Faktlar qayta tekshirildi va uchta ANIQLIK qo'shildi:

⚠ 1-band 'the largest desert' = Sahara. Bu — eng katta ISSIQ cho'l. Umuman eng katta cho'l esa ANTARKTIDA (~14 mln km2, sovuq cho'l). Kitobning javobi maktab darsligi darajasida to'g'ri.

⚠ 3-band 'the longest river' = the Nile (~6650 km). 2007-yildan beri ba'zi o'lchovlar AMAZONni uzunroq deb ko'rsatadi (~6992 km) — farq daryoning boshi qayerdan hisoblanishiga bog'liq. Maktab darsliklarida hamon Nil beriladi.

⚠ 2-banddagi Mount McKinley 2015-yildan rasman DENALI deb ataladi (tog'ning qadimiy mahalliy nomi).

⚠ 7-band 'the tallest building in the USA' = the Sears Tower — bu javob ESKIRGAN, lekin JSONda allaqachon qayd etilgan edi: bino hozir 'Willis Tower' deb ataladi va 2013-yildan One World Trade Center (541 m) undan balandroq.

⚠ Qolgan javoblar bugun ham TO'G'RI: Everest (8848 m), Atakama (Chili), Vatikan (0,44 km2), Death Valley (1913-yilda +56,7 C).

⚠ 12b-mashqda kitob ATAYLAB chalkashtiradi: 4-bandda uchala variant ham 'C' harfi bilan boshlanadi (Chile, Canada, China).

13-mashq jadvali (✓ soni) tekshirildi: taksi eng qimmat (✓✓✓), poyezd eng xavfsiz (✓✓✓), poyezd eng tez va eng qulay (✓✓✓).
audioRequiredUz: 11-mashqning 3, 4, 5-bandlari uchun kitob 'listen' deydi. Kitob 1 va 2-bandlarni O'ZI to'ldirgan (T va F) — bu ikkisi mantiqiy asosni beradi: London Edinburgdan ANCHA KATTA. Qolgan uchtasi shu asosdan ishonchli kelib chiqadi, har biri whyUz da tushuntirilgan. 12-mashq esa 'listen and check' bo'lsa ham, hamma javob GEOGRAFIK FAKT — audio kerak emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and put T (true) or F (false) next to each.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va har birining yoniga T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ShAHAR — rasmlardan:

  LONDON — Angliya poytaxti.
     Rasmda: Big Ben va Parlament binosi, Temza daryosi.
     Katta, gavjum, qimmat, ifloslangan.

  EDINBURGH — Shotlandiya poytaxti.
     Rasmda: gotik uslubdagi cherkov/yodgorlik.
     Ancha kichikroq, tinchroq, arzonroq.


KITOB IKKI JAVOBNI O'ZI BERGAN:
  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.        →  T
  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London. →  F

Bu ikkisi ASOSNI beradi:
  LONDON — ANCHA KATTA va ANCHA XAVFLIROQ shahar.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.        T  (kitob)
  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London. F  (kitob)
  3  Edinburgh is noisier than London.        F
  4  London is more polluted than Edinburgh.  T
  5  London is cheaper than Edinburgh.        F


DIQQAT — 3, 4, 5-BANDLAR QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Kitob bergan 1 va 2-band bir xil naqshni ko'rsatadi:
  LONDON hamma salbiy ko'rsatkichda oldinda
  (kattaroq, xavfliroq).

  Katta poytaxt = ko'proq odam, ko'proq mashina →
     shovqinliroq (3 → F, chunki LONDON shovqinliroq)
     ifloslanganroq (4 → T)
     qimmatroq (5 → F, chunki London QIMMATROQ)

  Bu — kitobning butun unit davomidagi mantiqiga
  ham mos: 82-betda LA (katta shahar) 'noisier,
  more expensive, more polluted, more crowded',
  Stratford (kichik shaharcha) esa 'cleaner,
  quieter, cheaper' edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Edinburgh   = Edinburg (Shotlandiya poytaxti,
                'EDIN-bara' deb o'qiladi)
  dangerous   = xavfli
  polluted    = ifloslangan

items.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN JAVOB — T.
Edinburg (~500 ming aholi) Londondan (~9 mln)
ancha kichik.
'smaller' — qisqa sifat + -ER.

items.sentence: 2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.
items.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN JAVOB — F.
Aksincha: LONDON xavfliroq.
Katta shaharda jinoyat ko'proq bo'ladi.
'more dangerous' — uzun sifat + MORE.

NOTO'G'RI (F).
LONDON shovqinliroq — u ancha kattaroq,
odam va transport ko'proq.
1-band Edinburgni KIChIKROQ deb tasdiqlagan;
kichik shahar tinchroq bo'ladi.
'noisier' — '-y' → -IER.

items.sentence: 4  London is more polluted than Edinburgh.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
London ancha kattaroq va transporti zichroq →
havo ifloslanganroq.
DIQQAT: bu bandda gap LONDON dan boshlanadi
(oldingilar Edinburgdan) — diqqat bilan o'qing.
'more polluted' — uzun sifat + MORE.

NOTO'G'RI (F).
Aksincha: London ANCHA QIMMATROQ —
u Yevropadagi eng qimmat shaharlardan biri.
Edinburgda yashash arzonroq.
'cheaper' — qisqa sifat + -ER.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, agree or disagree with the statements, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, gaplar bilan rozi bo'ling yoki rozi bo'lmang, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.  T
     'THAT'S TRUE. London ISN'T AS SMALL AS Edinburgh.
      ACTUALLY, Edinburgh is MUCH SMALLER THAN London.'

  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.  F
     'THAT'S FALSE. Edinburgh ISN'T AS DANGEROUS AS
      London. ACTUALLY, London is MUCH MORE DANGEROUS
      THAN Edinburgh.'


JAVOBNING QOLIPI — UCh QISM:

  1-qism:  'That's true.'  yoki  'That's false.'
           (rozi / rozi emas)

  2-qism:  'X ISN'T AS [sifat] AS Y.'
           (tenglikni INKOR qilish)

  3-qism:  'ACTUALLY, X is MUCH [qiyosiy] THAN Y.'
           ('actually' = aslida; 'much' kuchaytiradi)


DIQQAT — 'T' VA 'F' UChUN QOLIP FARQ QILADI:

  T bo'lsa:  gapdagi TARTIB saqlanadi
     (Edinburgh smaller → Edinburgh MUCH smaller)

  F bo'lsa:  tartib TESKARI bo'ladi
     (Edinburgh more dangerous → LONDON much more
      dangerous)


BARCHA BESh JAVOB:

  1  That's true. London isn't as small as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much smaller than London.

  2  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as dangerous as
     London. Actually, London is much more dangerous
     than Edinburgh.

  3  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as noisy as London.
     Actually, London is much noisier than Edinburgh.

  4  That's true. Edinburgh isn't as polluted as London.
     Actually, London is much more polluted than
     Edinburgh.

  5  That's false. London isn't as cheap as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much cheaper than London.


YANGI SO'Z:
  actually = aslida, aslini olganda
     Fikrni TUZATISh yoki ANIQLAShTIRISh uchun.
     DIQQAT: 'hozir' ma'nosini BERMAYDI
     (bu ko'p uchraydigan xato).

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI SAVOL — har birida qavsdagi sifatni
ORTTIRMA darajaga qo'yish kerak.

BARCHA ORTTIRMA ShAKLLAR:
  1  large  →  THE LARGEST
  2  high   →  THE HIGHEST
  3  long   →  THE LONGEST
  4  dry    →  THE DRIEST
  5  small  →  THE SMALLEST
  6  hot    →  THE HOTTEST
  7  tall   →  THE TALLEST


DIQQAT — IKKI MAXSUS HOLAT:

  4-band: DRY → THE DRIEST
     '-y' bilan tugagan → '-y' tushadi, '-IEST'.
     'the dryest' XATO.

  6-band: HOT → THE HOTTEST
     1 unli + 1 undosh → oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI.
     'the hotest' XATO.

  Qolgan beshtasi oddiy: -EST qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'THE' TUShIB QOLMASIN:
  Orttirma daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.
  'Which is largest desert?' XATO.
  'Which is THE largest desert?' TO'G'RI.

items.textEn: 1  Which is ............ (large) desert in the world?
items.whyUz:
large → THE LARGEST.
'-e' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -ST qo'shiladi.

items.textEn: 2  Which is ............ (high) mountain in the world?
items.whyUz:
high → THE HIGHEST.
Oddiy -EST qo'shilishi.
'high' = baland (tog', devor haqida).

items.textEn: 3  Which is ............ (long) river in the world?
4  Where is ............ (dry) place in the world?
items.whyUz:
dry → THE DRIEST.
'-y' tushadi, '-IEST' qo'shiladi.
'the dryest' XATO.
'dry' = quruq.

items.textEn: 5  Which is ............ (small) country in the world?
6  Where is ............ (hot) place in the world?
items.whyUz:
hot → THE HOTTEST.
1 unli + 1 undosh → 't' IKKILANADI.
'the hotest' XATO.
84-betdagi 'big → biggest' bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 7  Which is ............ (tall) building in the USA?
items.whyUz:
tall → THE TALLEST.
DIQQAT: 'tall' bino va odam uchun,
'high' esa tog' va devor uchun ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct item. Then, listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang. So'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI SAVOL — GEOGRAFIK BILIM SINOVI.
Hamma javob ANIQ FAKT, taxmin emas.

TO'LIQ SAVOL-JAVOBLAR:

  1  Which is the largest desert in the world?
     →  A  the Sahara (Sahroi Kabir)

  2  Which is the highest mountain in the world?
     →  C  Mount Everest (Everest tog'i)

  3  Which is the longest river in the world?
     →  C  the Nile (Nil daryosi)

  4  Where is the driest place in the world?
     →  A  in Chile (Chilida — Atakama cho'li)

  5  Which is the smallest country in the world?
     →  C  the State of the Vatican City (Vatikan)

  6  Where is the hottest place in the world?
     →  A  Death Valley (O'lim vodiysi, AQSh)

  7  Which is the tallest building in the USA?
     →  C  the Sears Tower (Sirs minorasi, Chikago)


ESLATMA — 7-BAND HAQIDA:
  Kitob chop etilgan paytda AQShdagi eng baland bino
  Chikagodagi Sears Tower (442 m) edi.
  Keyinchalik u Willis Tower deb qayta nomlangan,
  2013-yildan esa Nyu-Yorkdagi One World Trade Center
  (541 m) undan balandroq.
  Kitobning javobi — o'z davri uchun to'g'ri.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l qaysi? — Sahroi Kabir
  2  Dunyodagi eng baland tog' qaysi? — Everest
  3  Dunyodagi eng uzun daryo qaysi? — Nil
  4  Dunyodagi eng quruq joy qayerda? — Chilida
  5  Dunyodagi eng kichik davlat qaysi? — Vatikan
  6  Dunyodagi eng issiq joy qayerda? — O'lim vodiysi
  7  AQShdagi eng baland bino qaysi? — Sirs minorasi

items.textEn: 1  Which is the largest desert in the world?
items.whyUz:
A — SAHRA (Sahroi Kabir).
Shimoliy Afrikada, ~9 mln km2 —
deyarli AQSh kattaligida.
Gobi (Mo'g'uliston) va Nevada undan ancha kichik.

⚠⚠ MUHIM ANIQLIK: Sahroi Kabir — dunyodagi eng katta ISSIQ cho'l.
Umuman eng katta cho'l esa ANTARKTIDA (~14 mln km2) — u SOVUQ cho'l.
'Cho'l' deganda yomg'ir kam yog'adigan joy tushuniladi, issiq bo'lishi shart emas.
Kitobning javobi maktab darsligi uchun to'g'ri, lekin to'liq javob shu.

items.textEn: 2  Which is the highest mountain in the world?
items.whyUz:
C — MOUNT EVEREST (8848 m), Nepal/Xitoy chegarasida.
Ben Nevis (1345 m) — Shotlandiyaning eng baland
tog'i.
Mount McKinley (6190 m) — Shimoliy Amerikaning
eng balandi.
DIQQAT: tog' uchun 'HIGH', bino uchun 'TALL'.

⚠ ESLATMA: Mount McKinley 2015-yildan rasman DENALI deb ataladi — bu tog'ning mahalliy (atabask tilidagi) qadimiy nomi.

items.textEn: 3  Which is the longest river in the world?
items.whyUz:
C — NIL (~6650 km), Afrikada.
Missouri va Mississippi — AQShdagi daryolar,
nisbatan qisqaroq.

⚠⚠ BAHSLI JOY: an'anaviy javob — Nil (~6650 km).
Lekin 2007-yildan beri ba'zi o'lchovlar AMAZONni uzunroq deb ko'rsatadi (~6992 km).
Farq daryoning boshlanish nuqtasi qayerdan hisoblanishiga bog'liq.
Maktab darsliklarida hamon NIL deb beriladi — kitobning javobi shu.

items.textEn: 4  Where is the driest place in the world?
items.whyUz:
A — CHILIDA: Atakama cho'li.
Ba'zi joylarida yuzlab yil yomg'ir yog'magan.
DIQQAT: uchala variant ham 'C' harfi bilan
boshlanadi — ataylab chalkashtirish uchun.

items.textEn: 5  Which is the smallest country in the world?
items.answer: the State of the Vatican City
options: the State of the Vatican City
items.whyUz:
C — VATIKAN (0,44 km2), Rim ichida joylashgan.
Lyuksemburg (2586 km2) kichik, lekin Vatikandan
ming marta katta.
Uels — Buyuk Britaniya tarkibidagi o'lka,
mustaqil davlat EMAS.

items.textEn: 6  Where is the hottest place in the world?
items.whyUz:
A — DEATH VALLEY (O'lim vodiysi), Kaliforniya, AQSh.
1913-yilda +56,7 C qayd etilgan —
yer yuzidagi eng yuqori harorat.
Tokio va Malta issiq, lekin bunchalik emas.

items.textEn: 7  Which is the tallest building in the USA?
items.whyUz:
C — SEARS TOWER (442 m), Chikago.
Empire State Building (381 m) — Nyu-Yorkda,
John Hancock Centre (344 m) — Chikagoda.
ESLATMA: kitob chop etilgan davrda shunday edi.
Hozir Sears Tower 'Willis Tower' deb ataladi va
2013-yildan Nyu-Yorkdagi One World Trade Center
(541 m) undan balandroq.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: 'WHICH IS the largest desert in the world?'
  S2: 'THE LARGEST DESERT IN THE WORLD IS the Sahara.
       Which ...'

QOLIP — JAVOBDA SAVOL TAKRORLANADI:
  Savol:  Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world?
  Javob:  THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world IS + nom.

Bu — javobni TO'LIQ gap bilan berish usuli.
Og'zaki mashqda shunday javob berish talab qilinadi
(faqat 'the Sahara' deyish emas).

DIQQAT: har bir o'quvchi javob bergandan keyin
NAVBATDAGI savolni beradi ('Which ...' bilan
davom etadi).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — BRITANIYADAGI TRANSPORT:

 ┌───────────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┐
 │               │  BUSES  │ TRAINS  │  TAXIS  │
 ├───────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
 │ expensive     │    ✓    │   ✓✓    │  ✓✓✓    │
 │ safe          │   ✓✓    │  ✓✓✓    │   ✓     │
 │ fast          │    ✓    │  ✓✓✓    │  ✓✓     │
 │ comfortable   │    ✓    │  ✓✓✓    │  ✓✓     │
 └───────────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────┘

BELGILARNING MA'NOSI:
  ✓      →  ODDIY shakl        (expensive)
  ✓✓     →  QIYOSIY daraja     (more expensive than)
  ✓✓✓    →  ORTTIRMA daraja    (the most expensive of all)


KITOBDAGI TO'RT NAMUNA (birinchi qator):
  Buses in Britain are EXPENSIVE.
  Trains in Britain are MORE EXPENSIVE THAN buses.
  Taxis in Britain are THE MOST EXPENSIVE OF all.
  Buses in Britain AREN'T AS EXPENSIVE AS taxis.

Demak har bir qator uchun TO'RT gap tuziladi:
  1) ✓ li transport — oddiy shakl
  2) ✓✓ li transport — qiyosiy daraja + THAN
  3) ✓✓✓ li transport — orttirma daraja + OF ALL
  4) ✓ li transport AREN'T AS ... AS ✓✓✓ li transport


BARCHA TO'RT QATOR:

  EXPENSIVE  (buses ✓, trains ✓✓, taxis ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are expensive.
     Trains in Britain are more expensive than buses.
     Taxis in Britain are the most expensive of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as expensive as taxis.

  SAFE  (taxis ✓, buses ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Taxis in Britain are safe.
     Buses in Britain are safer than taxis.
     Trains in Britain are the safest of all.
     Taxis in Britain aren't as safe as trains.

  FAST  (buses ✓, taxis ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are fast.
     Taxis in Britain are faster than buses.
     Trains in Britain are the fastest of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as fast as trains.

  COMFORTABLE  (buses ✓, taxis ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are comfortable.
     Taxis in Britain are more comfortable than buses.
     Trains in Britain are the most comfortable of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as comfortable as trains.


DIQQAT — QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:
  expensive   → MORE / THE MOST   (3 bo'g'in)
  comfortable → MORE / THE MOST   (3 bo'g'in)
  safe        → safER / THE safEST ('-e' → faqat -R/-ST)
  fast        → fastER / THE fastEST (bir bo'g'in)

DIQQAT — 'SAFE' QATORI TESKARI:
  Boshqa uch qatorda avtobus eng past ko'rsatkichga
  ega, lekin 'safe' qatorida eng past — TAKSI (✓).
  Shuning uchun bu qatorda gaplar TAKSIdan boshlanadi.

DIQQAT — 'IN BRITAIN' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILMAYDI:
  Kitob har namunada 'in Britain' deb aytadi —
  gap FAQAT Britaniya haqida.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, talk about your city/town using the prompts below, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda, quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib o'z shahringiz haqida gaplashing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  old building, large park, busy road, popular cafe,
  expensive restaurant, famous square, pretty building

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WHICH IS THE OLDEST BUILDING in ...?'
  SB: 'I THINK the Town Hall is the oldest building in
       my city. WHICH IS THE LARGEST PARK?'


QOLIP:
  Savol:  Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in your city?
  Javob:  I THINK + [nom] is the [orttirma] [ot] in
          my city.  +  keyingi savol

  'I think ...' — o'z FIKRINGIZNI bildiradi
  (aniq fakt emas, shuning uchun yumshoqroq).


HAR BIR KO'RSATMANING ORTTIRMA ShAKLI:

  old building        →  the OLDEST building
  large park          →  the LARGEST park
  busy road           →  the BUSIEST road
  popular cafe        →  the MOST POPULAR cafe
  expensive restaurant→  the MOST EXPENSIVE restaurant
  famous square       →  the MOST FAMOUS square
  pretty building     →  the PRETTIEST building


DIQQAT — YASALISh QOIDALARI:
  old    → oldEST      (bir bo'g'in)
  large  → largEST     ('-e' → faqat -ST)
  busy   → busIEST     ('-y' → -IEST)
  pretty → prettIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  popular   → THE MOST popular    (3 bo'g'in)
  expensive → THE MOST expensive  (3 bo'g'in)
  famous    → THE MOST famous     (2 bo'g'in)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a Town Hall = shahar hokimiyati binosi
  a square    = maydon
  pretty      = chiroyli, ko'rkam
  busy        = gavjum, band

exercises.instructionEn: Which is the oldest building, the largest park, the busiest road, the most popular cafe, the most expensive restaurant, the most famous square/building in your town/city? Write a short paragraph about your town/city. Start like this: I live in ... . It is in ...
exercises.instructionUz: Shahringizdagi eng eski bino, eng katta park, eng gavjum yo'l, eng mashhur kafe, eng qimmat restoran, eng mashhur maydon/bino qaysi? Shahringiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing. Shunday boshlang: I live in ... . It is in ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh:
  'I live in ... . It is in ...'

OLTI ORTTIRMA DARAJANI ISHLATISh KERAK:
  the oldest building
  the largest park
  the busiest road
  the most popular cafe
  the most expensive restaurant
  the most famous square/building


TO'LIQ NAMUNA (Toshkent haqida):

  I live in Tashkent. It is in the east of Uzbekistan
  and it is the capital city of my country. It is a
  large, modern and very busy city.

  The oldest building in my city is the Kukeldash
  Madrasah. The largest park is the Ecopark and the
  busiest road is Amir Temur Street. There is heavy
  traffic there every morning.

  The most popular cafe is in the city centre and the
  most expensive restaurant is in a big hotel near
  the square. The most famous square in Tashkent is
  Independence Square.

  Tashkent is noisy and crowded, but it is also
  fascinating. I love living here!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Men Toshkentda yashayman. U O'zbekistonning
  sharqida joylashgan va mamlakatimning poytaxti.
  Bu katta, zamonaviy va juda gavjum shahar.

  Shahrimdagi eng eski bino — Ko'kaldosh madrasasi.
  Eng katta park — Ekopark, eng gavjum yo'l esa
  Amir Temur ko'chasi. U yerda har kuni ertalab
  zich transport oqimi bo'ladi.

  Eng mashhur kafe shahar markazida, eng qimmat
  restoran esa maydon yonidagi katta mehmonxonada.
  Toshkentdagi eng mashhur maydon — Mustaqillik
  maydoni.

  Toshkent shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda
  maftunkor. Men bu yerda yashashni yaxshi ko'raman!


DIQQAT — 83-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN NAMUNA OLING:
  Oxirgi jumla LA maqolasining oxiri bilan bir xil
  qolipda: 'It's noisy and crowded, BUT it's also
  fascinating.'
  Kamchilikni aytib, ijobiy nota bilan tugatish.

DIQQAT — 'THE' TUShIB QOLMASIN:
  Har bir orttirma daraja oldida 'THE' bo'lishi shart.

structure.heading: 1-xatboshi — KIRISh
structure.guideUz:
Kitob bergan boshlanish:
'I live in ... . It is in ...'
Keyin 2-3 sifat bilan umumiy tasvir.
structure.modelEn: I live in Tashkent. It is in the east of Uzbekistan and it is the capital city of my country. It is a large, modern and very busy city.

structure.heading: 2-xatboshi — BINOLAR VA YO'LLAR
structure.headingUz: Eng eski bino, eng katta park, eng gavjum yo'l
structure.guideUz:
Uchta orttirma daraja:
the oldest building, the largest park,
the busiest road.
structure.modelEn: The oldest building in my city is the Kukeldash Madrasah. The largest park is the Ecopark and the busiest road is Amir Temur Street. There is heavy traffic there every morning.

structure.heading: 3-xatboshi — KAFE, RESTORAN, MAYDON
structure.headingUz: Eng mashhur kafe, eng qimmat restoran, eng mashhur maydon
structure.guideUz:
Uchta orttirma daraja — hammasi
'THE MOST' bilan (uzun sifatlar).
structure.modelEn: The most popular cafe is in the city centre and the most expensive restaurant is in a big hotel near the square. The most famous square in Tashkent is Independence Square.

structure.heading: 4-xatboshi — XULOSA
structure.guideUz:
83-betdagi maqolaning oxiri kabi:
kamchilikni aytib, ijobiy nota bilan tugating
('..., but it is also ...').
structure.modelEn: Tashkent is noisy and crowded, but it is also fascinating. I love living here!

exercises.instructionEn: First, listen and repeat. Then, take roles and act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval tinglang va takrorlang. So'ng rollarga bo'linib dialoglarni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh QISQA DIALOG — SAYOHAT HAQIDA FIKR BILDIRISh.

  a)  David: What was New York like?
      Julie: Great! The people were really friendly and
             there were lots of interesting places to
             visit!

  b)  Mary: Did you like Ibiza?
      Tony: No, I hated it. It was too crowded and the
            hotel was too noisy.

  c)  John:  What did you think of Paris?
      Sarah: It was fantastic! It had some excellent
             shops and we ate at some wonderful
             restaurants.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a)  Devid: Nyu-York qanday edi?
      Juli:  Ajoyib! Odamlar juda do'stona edi va
             borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar ko'p edi!

  b)  Meri: Ibitsa senga yoqdimi?
      Toni: Yo'q, yomon ko'rdim. U juda gavjum edi va
            mehmonxona juda shovqinli edi.

  c)  Jon:  Parij haqida nima deb o'ylading?
      Sara: Ajoyib edi! U yerda a'lo do'konlar bor edi
            va biz zo'r restoranlarda ovqatlandik.


UCh XIL FIKR SO'RASh QOLIPI — ENG MUHIMI:

  1)  'What was + joy + LIKE?'
         = ... qanday edi?
      DIQQAT: bu yerda 'like' 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.
      Bu — TASVIRLASh so'raydi.
      Javob: sifat bilan ('Great!', 'It was fantastic!')

  2)  'DID YOU LIKE + joy?'
         = ... senga yoqdimi?
      Bu — HA/YO'Q savoli.
      Javob: 'Yes, I loved it.' / 'No, I hated it.'

  3)  'What did you THINK OF + joy?'
         = ... haqida nima deb o'ylading?
      DIQQAT: 'think OF' — predlog OF.
      Javob: fikr + sabab.


JAVOB BERISh — IJOBIY va SALBIY:

  IJOBIY:
     Great!            = Ajoyib!
     It was fantastic! = Zo'r edi!
     I loved it.       = Juda yoqdi.
     really friendly   = juda do'stona
     excellent shops   = a'lo do'konlar
     wonderful restaurants = zo'r restoranlar

  SALBIY:
     I hated it.       = Yomon ko'rdim.
     too crowded       = juda gavjum
     too noisy         = juda shovqinli


DIQQAT — 'TOO' NING MA'NOSI:
  'too' = HADDAN TAShQARI (salbiy ma'no).
     'too crowded' = juda gavjum (yomon)
     'very crowded' = juda gavjum (betaraf)
  'too' doim MUAMMO borligini bildiradi.

DIQQAT — HAMMA GAP O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  was / were / did / had / ate / hated
  Sayohat TUGAGAN, shuning uchun past simple.

DIQQAT — 'SOME' IJOBIY GAPDA:
  'some excellent shops', 'some wonderful restaurants'
  Tasdiq gapda 'some' ishlatiladi ('any' emas).

sentences.en: a) David: What was New York like?
sentences.noteUz:
'What was X LIKE?' = X qanday edi?
DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS —
TASVIRLASh so'raydi.

sentences.en: a) Julie: Great! The people were really friendly and there were lots of interesting places to visit!
sentences.uz: Juli: Ajoyib! Odamlar juda do'stona edi va borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar ko'p edi!
sentences.noteUz:
IJOBIY javob.
'The people WERE' — 'people' KO'PLIK.
'there were lots of ...' = ... ko'p edi.
'places TO VISIT' = borib ko'radigan joylar.

sentences.en: b) Mary: Did you like Ibiza?
sentences.noteUz:
'Did you like ...?' — HA/YO'Q savoli.
DID + you + LIKE (asosiy shakl).
Ibitsa — Ispaniyadagi mashhur orol.

sentences.en: b) Tony: No, I hated it. It was too crowded and the hotel was too noisy.
sentences.uz: Toni: Yo'q, yomon ko'rdim. U juda gavjum edi va mehmonxona juda shovqinli edi.
sentences.noteUz:
SALBIY javob.
'to hate' = yomon ko'rmoq ('to love' ning aksi).
'TOO crowded' — 'too' HADDAN TASHQARI degani,
doim salbiy ma'noda.

sentences.en: c) John: What did you think of Paris?
sentences.uz: Jon: Parij haqida nima deb o'ylading?
sentences.noteUz:
'What did you think OF ...?' — predlog OF.
Fikr so'rashning uchinchi usuli.
'think about' ham bor, lekin fikr so'raganda
'think OF' ishlatiladi.

sentences.en: c) Sarah: It was fantastic! It had some excellent shops and we ate at some wonderful restaurants.
sentences.uz: Sara: Ajoyib edi! U yerda a'lo do'konlar bor edi va biz zo'r restoranlarda ovqatlandik.
sentences.noteUz:
IJOBIY javob.
'ate' — 'eat' ning o'tgan shakli (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'eat AT a restaurant' — predlog AT (84-bet, 6-mashq).
'SOME' tasdiq gapda ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: That's true/false. X isn't as [sifat] as Y. Actually, Y is much [qiyosiy] than X.
patterns.exampleEn: That's false. Edinburgh isn't as dangerous as London. Actually, London is much more dangerous than Edinburgh.
patterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri. Edinburg Londonchalik xavfli emas. Aslida, London Edinburgdan ancha xavfliroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
Rozi bo'lish / bo'lmaslikning UCH qismli qolipi.
'actually' = aslida (fikrni tuzatadi).

patterns.formula: Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world?  —  THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world IS + nom.
patterns.exampleEn: Which is the largest desert in the world? — The largest desert in the world is the Sahara.
patterns.exampleUz: Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l qaysi? — Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l Sahroi Kabir.
patterns.explanationUz:
Javobda savol TAKRORLANADI —
og'zaki mashqda to'liq gap talab qilinadi.

patterns.formula: X is the [orttirma] OF ALL.   /   X isn't AS [sifat] AS Y.
patterns.exampleEn: Taxis in Britain are the most expensive of all. Buses in Britain aren't as expensive as taxis.
patterns.exampleUz: Britaniyadagi taksilar hammasidan qimmat. Britaniyadagi avtobuslar taksilarchalik qimmat emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
'the ... OF ALL' — uch va undan ko'p narsadan
eng yuqorisi.
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.

patterns.formula: I THINK + [nom] is the [orttirma] [ot] in my city.
patterns.exampleEn: I think the Town Hall is the oldest building in my city.
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, shahar hokimiyati binosi shahrimdagi eng eski bino.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I think ...' javobni YUMShATADI —
aniq fakt emas, shaxsiy fikr.

patterns.formula: What was + joy + LIKE?   /   What did you THINK OF + joy?
patterns.exampleEn: What was New York like? What did you think of Paris?
patterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York qanday edi? Parij haqida nima deb o'ylading?
patterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat haqida fikr so'rash.
'What was ... like?' da 'like' — 'qanday',
'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.

patterns.exampleEn: It was too crowded and the hotel was too noisy.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda gavjum edi va mehmonxona juda shovqinli edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'too' = HADDAN TASHQARI — doim MUAMMO borligini
bildiradi ('very' esa betaraf).
